entities.summary: Brandon Robert Brown is an American professional basketball player who last played for CSM Oradea of the Romanian Liga Națională (LNBM). In his career, he has also played in France, Russia, Poland, Romania, Bulgaria, Brazil, Australia, Cyprus, Greece and Israel.
